  -v /run/user/1000/podman/podman.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:Z \\
  --user 1000:1000 \\
  mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/dotnet:1-10.0 \\

  mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/dotnet:1-10.0 \\
